author: A. B. Schroeder
title: Judy Jacobs Parkway Elementary counted 35 Hispanic students for 2025-26
text:
Judy Jacobs Parkway Elementary School saw 35 Hispanic students enrolled during the 2025-26 school year, a rise of 9.4% from the prior year, the New York State Education Department reported.
The available data indicated 481 total students at Judy Jacobs Parkway Elementary that year, with Hispanic students making up 7.3%—the school’s third-largest ethnic group.
This campus is part of the Plainview-Old Bethpage Central School District, whose central office is in Plainview.
Within the district’s seven schools, Plainview-Old Bethpage/Jfk High School had the highest number of Hispanic students at that time, with 123 enrollments.
World Population Review’s analysis determined that New York had the nation’s second-highest overall ranking for public education , while it placed 31st for K-12 performance.
